title: Kaaviya Thalaivan
desc: Two rival artists at Sivadas Swamigal's drama troupe compete in everything they do. While one of them goes on to become successful, the other fails in life.

title: Adanga Maru
desc: Subhash, a daredevil officer, raises his voice against injustice when he comes across a few politically influential people. However, when his family is brutally murdered, he sets out to exact revenge.

title: Amaran
desc: Major Mukund Varadarajan, a commissioned officer in the Rajput Regiment of the Indian Army, conducts a counterterrorism operation while being deployed to Jammu and Kashmir.

title: IPC 376
desc: A police officer looks into an informer who can predict future murders in a mysterious way. Soon, she unearths a sinister murder mystery that leads to a shocking truth.

desc: After one of them falls inside a dangerous pit in the Guna Caves, a group of childhood friends muster courage to rescue him out of a space from where a return is next to impossible.

title: HIT: The Second Case
desc: Krishna Dev, a police officer, handles a complicated murder case. As he attempts to solve the crime, a bigger criminal network is revealed.

title: Chitralahari
desc: Depressed with the constant failures in his personal and professional life, Vijay is in search of an opportunity to prove himself. While no one believes him, Swecha decides to give him a chance.

title: Thanivazhi
desc: An aspiring cricketer's dreams are shattered when he becomes a victim of circumstance and turns to the world of crime to get back at the policeman who ruined his life.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.

title: Jigarthanda
desc: A budding director tries to research a merciless gangster for making a film on gangsterism. But his secret attempts to conduct the research fail when he gets caught for snooping.

title: Manithan
desc: In order to earn quick money and fame, a struggling lawyer accepts a bribe and joins hands with a man who pretends to be a witness in a case. However, his conscience forces him to fight for justice.

title: Thittam Irandu
desc: While her marriage preparations are underway, Inspector Athira is busy investigating the death of her friend Deepa. Later, her life turns upside down when the whole mystery unfolds before her eyes.

title: Ragalai
desc: Karthik's mother decides to marry him to her brother's daughter Indu. However, when the uncle insults Karthik's family, he goes on a mission to destroy him.

desc: M S Dhoni, a boy from Ranchi, aspires to play cricket for India. Though he initially tries to please his father by working for the Indian Railways, he ultimately decides to chase his dreams.

title: Nanban
desc: Two friends set out to find their friend from college, who taught them how to be more than just victims of circumstance. Along the way, they discover previously unknown truths.

title: Petromax
desc: Saravanan, an Indian living abroad, struggles to sell his ancestral home in India due to the supposed presence of ghosts in it. He devises a plan to prove that his house is not haunted.
